_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: Loads anima-base-v1.0 (Anima 1.0), the anime-tuned panel model (design 4-fix 'adopt Anima 1.0 for panels'). Full safetensors -- auto-detected as Anima by model_detection (qwen3_06b + t5 tokenizer pair). image_router.pick_* only routes here when this file is on disk at full size and the anima smoke gate has passed.

_meta.title: CLIP
_meta.note: Anima text encoder: qwen3_06b_base.safetensors (1.2 GB). The loaded quant is auto-detected as TEModel.QWEN3_06B regardless of the 'type' arg (comfy/sd.py), so the blueprint's stable_diffusion type is retained verbatim.

_meta.title: VAE
_meta.note: Qwen-Image VAE (AutoencoderKLQwenImage, 16-channel latent, Wan21 format) -- same VAE krea2 uses, already on disk.

_meta.title: PROMPT_POS
_meta.note: The assembled sd_prompt lands here (patched per shot by ComfyClient).

_meta.title: PROMPT_NEG
_meta.note: Anima 1.0 is NOT cfg-distilled (configfg 4.0), so it takes a real text negative like a classic anime checkpoint. PROMPT_NEG is patched by ComfyClient (a fixed quality blacklist by default).

inputs.text: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, blurry, jpeg artifacts, sepia

_meta.title: LATENT
_meta.note: 16-channel latent canvas (Wan21/Qwen-image VAE). Patched to 1024x1024 base; panels/plates are patched to the stage resolution.

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: Anima 1.0 official recipe (image_anima_base_v1 blueprint, 2026-08-08): er_sde/simple, 30 steps, cfg 4.0, denoise 1.0 for txt2img. SEED patched per shot from hash(scene_id, shot_id, retry).

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient copies it into the project dir.
